channel.title: Capital raising: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New capital raising filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: GnCo decided a third-party allotment rights offering of 1,113,172 new common shares at KRW 2,695 each, to repay convertible bond debt.
Aprogen resolved on Nov 20, 2026 to issue 1,428,571 new common shares at KRW 1,400 each via a public offering.
Softcamp's board decided to issue KRW 1.0bn of 0% unsecured private-placement convertible bonds, Series 3, maturing 30 November 2029.
Mgen Solutions decides to issue KRW 10.0bn Series 26 private convertible bonds, convertible into 9,560,229 new common shares at KRW 1,046.
WooGeneB&GCO decides to issue 600,000 new common shares at KRW 2,500 to J Global fund, raising KRW 1.5bn.
Ryuk-il C&S subsidiary Combustech decides KRW 3.0bn rights offering of 300,000 new common shares at KRW 10,000 each
Hansaemk resolves third-party allotment of 10,455,564 new shares at KRW 1,339 to majority shareholder in debt-to-equity conversion.
Genesystem's board decided to issue KRW 2.43bn of Series 2 private convertible bonds to fund a business acquisition.
Voronoi's board resolved on Nov 13, 2026 to issue KRW 52.7bn of Series 5 private convertible bonds for working capital.
PionEx amended its rights offering filing to set the final issue price at KRW 1,046, cutting new shares to 1,912,045.
Moa Life Plus amended its April 2026 convertible bond issuance filing to withdraw the decision, citing contract cancellation.
Samyoung ENC amended its rights-offering report, correcting pre-increase shares outstanding to 6,569,366 from 6,569,206 after reverse-split fractional share handling.
B2EN decides to issue KRW 10.0bn Series 7 private-placement convertible bonds, maturing 20 November 2029.
Vaiv Company resolved a KRW 5.0bn third-party private placement of 3,840,245 new common shares at KRW 1,302 per share to AI Blazer.
Vaiv Company decided a third-party allotment rights offering of 2,346,938 new common shares at KRW 1,274 per share, payment due 20 November 2026.
NGeneBio will issue 2,000,000 new common shares at KRW 1,000 to its largest shareholder via third-party allotment, raising KRW 2.0bn for debt repayment.
NGeneBio's board decided a KRW 6.0bn third-party allotment of 6,000,000 new common shares at KRW 1,000 per share to its largest shareholder.
Seojin System decided to issue KRW 60.0bn of Series 44 unsecured private-placement convertible bonds, with a conversion price of KRW 33,430.
Seojin System's board decided on Nov 6, 2026 to issue KRW 60.0bn of Series 45 private-placement convertible bonds to fund acquisition of other companies' securities.
Organic Tea Cosmetics decided on a third-party allotment of 50,000,000 new common shares at KRW 2,025 each, raising KRW 101.25bn.
Chasys decided a third-party allotment rights offering of 1,578,947 common shares at KRW 3,800 each to Park Jong-gap, raising about KRW 6.0bn.
Chasys decided a third-party allotment rights offering of 789,473 common shares at KRW 3,800 each to Le L Partners for working capital.
Xiilab board approved a KRW 10.0bn zero-coupon private convertible bond on Nov 6, 2026, for working capital.
TC Materials decided to issue KRW 30.0bn in second-series private convertible bonds, with a conversion price of KRW 4,290 per share.
Taesung's board resolved on Nov 5, 2026 to issue KRW 70.0bn of 0% private-placement convertible bonds due Nov 19, 2031.
EcoGlow's board decided on Nov 4, 2026 a public paid-in capital increase of 1,031,282 new common shares at KRW 2,909 each.
Proteina decided to issue KRW 29.2bn of unsecured private-placement convertible bonds, maturing 12 November 2031, with a conversion price of KRW 48,061.
Lunit decided to issue KRW 47.7bn of Series 3 unsecured private-placement convertible bonds, with a conversion price of KRW 15,303.
Proteina decides third-party allotment of 151,886 registered convertible preferred shares at KRW 48,061 each, raising about KRW 7.30bn.
FSN decided to issue KRW 3.0bn of Series 16 private convertible bonds for working capital, maturing 12 November 2029.
Hanwool N Jeju decided on a public offering of 3,599,929 new common shares at a tentative KRW 611 per share to fund operations.
Bitmax decided a third-party allotment of 13,961,520 new common shares to Korea Advanced Materials for an in-kind contribution of KRW 21.6bn.
Kwangjin Industrial's board resolved on 2 Nov 2026 to issue KRW 10.0bn of Series 5 private convertible bonds, due 16 Nov 2029.
